title: KG-DF: A Black-box Defense Framework against Jailbreak Attacks Based on Knowledge Graphs
reasoning: The paper's proposed defense framework (KG-DF) incorporates a 'Safety Knowledge Module' and a 'General Knowledge Module' that explicitly include subcategories for religion, bias (including religious bias), ethics (including ethical critique and law and ethics), and moral philosophy. These components are used as part of the reasoning process to identify and block harmful prompts.
